description: This file is a shell script used for testing various Git clone options and behaviors, including shallow clones, remote naming, configuration precedence, and branch initialization.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, with a description.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output files.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global Git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a directory or file path is missing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a specified repository.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup or finalization command after tests.
